case.cohort_note: Assumed 50,000 concert departures across three modes; mode shares and reference rates transferred from the historical FIFA final. Not observed concert attendance.

source.title: NJ TRANSIT interagency after-action report: FIFA World Cup operations
source.extraction: Manually transcribed eight match columns from the Ridership & Service Data table; egress passenger and duration rows only. Checked against the published table.
limits: Agency-reported aggregates have not been independently audited.
Mode counts and American Dream pedestrian counts are not a disjoint accounting of all spectators; do not sum pedestrian and mode counts.
The report includes negative unallocated totals and estimated categories; those categories are excluded from this model.
Egress duration is a system clearance window, not an individual passenger's waiting time.
This is a retrospective 2026 case and future-event scenario tool, not a pre-tournament forecast.

rice.label: Organizer sample data — transformed; method demonstration only
limitations: Not actual urban conditions or a FIFA visitor OD matrix.
Visitation totals are perturbed visits, not unique people.
Spatial cells are approximately 5 km and jittered; they are not street-level evidence.
UHI is retained as a 1–11 sample index, never converted to degrees.
Weather values are transformed historical observations, not a 2026 forecast.
rice.coverage: Full scan of all available compressed shards; no row cap. Market labels and coordinates are organizer-transformed.

acs.class: Derived estimate from ACS survey estimates
acs.scope: Resident county context, not visitor characteristics or an ADA audit. ACS margins of error retained.

assumptions.name: Reference service rates
assumptions.value: Reported final-match passengers ÷ reported clearance hours
assumptions.limit: Realized throughput is not maximum capacity; source includes rail contingency operations.

assumptions.name: Demand release
assumptions.value: Assumed 50,000 concert departures released together at concert end
assumptions.limit: Conservative fluid-queue abstraction; not actual arrival observations.

assumptions.name: Voluntary mode shift
assumptions.value: Up to 20% of rideshare cohort, bounded by added coach seats
assumptions.limit: Tested at 50–150% effectiveness; no causal evidence.

assumptions.name: Intervention costs
assumptions.value: One-event incremental low / central / high allowances
assumptions.limit: Costs include planned delivery allowance; require local vendor and agency review.

assumptions.name: Emissions boundary
assumptions.value: Affected rideshare and incremental coach legs only: 2.2 people/car, 18 km car trip, 0.192 kg/car-km; 12 km coach cycle-distance basis, 50% extra deadhead, 1.2 kg/bus-km
assumptions.limit: Not total tournament emissions; tests can show negative savings.

assumptions.name: Accessible demand target
assumptions.value: Planning target = 8% of the three-cohort demand
assumptions.limit: Not measured disability prevalence. Equity objective prioritizes accessible-service seats.

assumptions.name: Heat exposure
assumptions.limit: Organizer UHI contributes only a relative scenario index; no degree conversion or health outcome claim.

assumptions.name: Street / last-mile conditions
assumptions.value: OSM geometry + MTA current regular subway snapshot
assumptions.limit: NJ TRANSIT FIFA GTFS, observed road counts and accessible-path audit are not ingested. No street traffic or ADA claims.

validation.method: Leave one match out: estimate median realized passengers/hour on seven matches; predict the excluded match clearance window. All eight held-out cases shown.
validation.scope: Tests aggregate baseline transfer only; does not validate an intervention, individual waits, or a street-level model.
